title: A blockwise separable ball depends only on the smaller compression dimension

statement.quantifiers: Every integers s,b>=1 and Hermitian E on C^s tensor C^b with ||E||op<=eps<=1/(2s-1).
statement.assertion: I+E is separable independently of b. For the candidate W=I-32G with q_r(G)<=1/(64r), every complex first-factor isometric compression to s<=r is separable; J(P)=W/d therefore gives (id_r tensor P)(X) separable for every PSD input X, without assuming P completely positive.
assumptions: E is Hermitian with operator-norm bound; blocks need not commute.
Separable means a sum of positive tensor factors without trace normalization.
Application uses all complex isometries U and universal bilinear Schmidt norm q_r, not finite samples.

inputs: Hermitian block matrix E; for the map application, Choi perturbation with exact factor order and q_r bound.
outputs: Explicit sum of positive tensor factors and separability under arbitrary local filtering; extension from pure inputs to all PSD inputs.
interface.precision: Finite algebraic ball, inclusive norm boundary; no optimality or historical-novelty assertion. The AN random-map acquisition and bit complexity are separate.
costs: A direct decomposition uses O(s²) matrix tensor summands; storing dense b-by-b factors and obtaining norm certificates have their own costs.
Map existence threshold d>=2^23 r³; rational search has not been executed and no efficient certificate/compiler is provided.

proof_mechanism: Split each off-diagonal block into Hermitian real/imaginary parts H,K with norms<=eps.
Use .5(Pij+Xij) tensor(eps I+H)+.5(Pij-Xij) tensor(eps I-H), and the analogous Y,K identity.
Each diagonal is charged2eps(s-1); residual I+Eii-2eps(s-1)I is >=[1-(2s-1)eps]I.
Compress W with U: perturbation norm<=32q_r<=1/(2r)<=1/(2s-1).
Write pure input psi=(A tensor V)Omega_s. Choi contraction is (A tensor I)(V^T tensor I)J(P)(overline V tensor I)(A* tensor I), so U=overline V, not V.
Local filters preserve separability; sum rank-one PSD inputs. Adjoint coefficient g^T is factor-swapped and obeys the same bounds.
obstructions: Finite-reference EB of positive non-CP maps is not the physical CP entanglement-breaking channel definition.
For each finite r a map exists, not one fixed map for every reference or tensor power.
PPT or positive compressions alone are insufficient; the decomposition proves actual separability.

potential_uses.transfer_gate: Acquire a universal operator bound for every complex isometric compression and the correctly conjugated Choi/filter identity. Charge dimension and bit acquisition; do not infer all-tensor-power positivity.

review.source_reported: Source internal derivations/audits and finite checks reported; no independent ingestion proof reconstruction, scientific replay, external correctness or priority clearance.
